entries.title: Psalms 93:1
segments: The LORD reigns, He is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength. He clothed Himself and the world is established; it shall not be shaken.

entries.title: Psalms 93:2
segments: Your throne [is] established of old; You [are] from everlasting.

entries.title: Psalms 93:3
segments: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voices; the floods lift up their waves.

entries.title: Psalms 93:4
segments: The LORD on high [is] mightier than the noise of many waters, than the mighty waves of the sea.

entries.title: Psalms 93:5
segments: Your testimonies are very sure; holiness becomes Your house forever, O LORD.
